Maya Rao: Heads-up — localized snippets on /optimize/guide (es, fr) are rendering with curly quotes instead of backticks, so fenced code blocks collapse in the translated pages. Repro: go to /es/optimize/batching -> example section.

Liam Chen: ugh, saw that. Looks like the translation export step replaced `\`\`` with \u2018/\u2019. Probably the i18n pipeline sanitizer. Found it in build log: `i18n-export v1.2.0` warning about smart quotes.

Helena Ortiz: Can someone paste the minimal repro snippet? I can open a quick docs PR to patch the source files (escape + use html <code> fallback) and run the preview.

Maya Rao: Minimal repro (from localized md):
```markdown
```python
from redwood.optimize import suggest_batches
print(suggest_batches([100, 200]))
```
```
In the localized file it becomes: ‘‘“from redwood.optimize ... ”’’ which kills the fence.

Sanjay Patel: I pushed a quick fix branch that normalizes backticks during export: `fix/i18n-preserve-backticks-171420`. The PR is at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4446 — includes a unit test for the exporter.

Helena Ortiz: Nice. I looked at the PR — two small comments: (1) escape HTML entities in codeblock captions, (2) add a note in the migration guide about legacy MDX exporters. Can you add them quickly?

Sanjay Patel: Will do. Patch snippet I added to exporter (JS):
```js
// force-preserve backticks in code spans
text = text.replace(/[\u2018\u2019\u201C\u201D]/g, '`');
```
Added a test that runs `node tools/i18n-export.js fixtures/localized-md.md` in CI.

Liam Chen: docs-bot preview is available: <https://deploy-preview-4446--redwood-docs.netlify.app/optimize/batching?locale=es> — looks good now. (reaction :eyes:)

Maya Rao: Great. Two follow-ups: 1) backport to release/v2.3 (customers using packaged private docs), 2) add an entry in changelog under Optimize Toolkit -> localization fixes.

Helena Ortiz: I'll do the changelog and backport once CI passes. Also updating the SDK snippet examples to include both Python and JS replicas so localized pages don't rely on translators to duplicate code.

Sanjay Patel: CI green, tests added. Merging after approvals.

Maya Rao: Approved. Thanks all — assign docs-qa to sanity-check live site after merge.

docs-bot: Merge queued by Sanjay Patel — merging when checks pass.

Helena Ortiz: Follow-up note for docs maintainers: when producing localized exports, run `node tools/i18n-export.js --preserve-backticks` or the new env var `I18N_PRESERVE_BACKTICKS=true`. I'll add this to the contributor guide.

Maya Rao: Logged a short migration snippet for the Optimize toolkit: /contrib/i18n.md -> section "Preserving code fences". I'll link it from the main guide after merge. (reaction :white_check_mark:)
